# Every scalar type in, one string out: a|b|c|d|e|f|g.

@example
-2147483648
-9223372036854775808
4294967295
-0.125
true
"x"
"hello world"
=> "-2147483648|-9223372036854775808|4294967295|-0.125|1|x|hello world"

2147483647
9223372036854775807
0
2.5
false
" "
""
=> "2147483647|9223372036854775807|0|2.5|0| |"
